vv77:1.1: idaṃ maṇithūṇaṃ vimānaṃ samantato dvādasa yojanāni kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā veḷuriyatthambhā rucakatthatā subhā. || ||
vv77:2.1: Tatth' acchasi pivasi khādasī ca dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vaggū dibbā rasā kāmaguṇ' ettha pañca nāriyo ca naccanti suvaṇṇachannā.
vv77:5.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto vivane pathe saṅkamanaṃ akāsiṃ ārāmarukkhāni ca ropayissaṃ piyā ca me sīlavanto ahesuṃ annañ ca pānañ ca pasannacitto sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
